# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 6 tokens; Text — 5 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Borders and rings — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 82 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 28 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 5 tokens; Motion — 3 tokens; Other — 3 tokens; Font weight — 6 tokens; Letter spacing — 5 tokens; Line height — 3 tokens.

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-body);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-headline);   /* the family alone */
```

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headline` | `--font-headline` | `"PP Agrandir Wide","PP Agrandir Grand",system-ui,sans-serif` |
| `headline-alt` | `--font-headline-alt` | `"PP Agrandir Grand",system-ui,sans-serif` |
| `subheadline` | `--font-subheadline` | `"Big Shoulders Display","TitlingGothicFB Comp",Oswald,system-ui,sans-serif` |
| `body` | `--font-body` | `"Work Sans",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif` |
| `icon` | `--font-icon` | `"Font Awesome 6 Sharp","Font Awesome 6 Free"` |

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says and `upload_asset` it where you use it — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url upload_asset returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `fonts/<id>` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PP Agrandir Wide | `fonts/PPAgrandir-WideBlack.ttf` (weight 900) | `read_file fonts/PPAgrandir-WideBlack.ttf` | `var(--font-headline)` | `pp-agrandir-wide` |
| PP Agrandir Grand | `fonts/PPAgrandir-GrandRegular.ttf` (weight 400) | `read_file fonts/PPAgrandir-GrandRegular.ttf` | `var(--font-headline)` | `pp-agrandir-grand` |
| PP Agrandir | `fonts/PPAgrandir-WideBlack.ttf` (weight 900) | `read_file fonts/PPAgrandir-WideBlack.ttf` |  | `pp-agrandir` |

Every face: `fonts/PPAgrandir-WideBlack.ttf` (PP Agrandir Wide, 900), `fonts/PPAgrandir-WideBlackItalic.ttf` (PP Agrandir Wide, 900, italic), `fonts/PPAgrandir-GrandLight.ttf` (PP Agrandir Grand, 300), `fonts/PPAgrandir-GrandLightItalic.ttf` (PP Agrandir Grand, 300, italic), `fonts/PPAgrandir-GrandRegular.ttf` (PP Agrandir Grand, 400), `fonts/PPAgrandir-GrandRegularItalic.ttf` (PP Agrandir Grand, 400, italic), `fonts/PPAgrandir-WideBlackItalic.ttf` (PP Agrandir, 900, italic), `fonts/PPAgrandir-WideBlack.ttf` (PP Agrandir, 900).
